title: Annotatio III §.VI: Berengar follows Bertram’s orthodox Eucharist opinion — yet crudely, almost a naked figure
pass_a_gloss: When Berengar, following indeed Bertram’s Orthodox Opinion concerning the Eucharist, even with many accomplices and followers, yet somewhat crudely seemed to say the consecrated bread was almost a naked Figure of Christ’s body.
pass_b_english: Berengar follows Bertram’s orthodox Eucharist opinion (with many allies).
Yet he seems to speak crudely: consecrated bread almost a naked Figure of Christ’s body.
source_text: Cùm Berengarius Bertrami Orthodoxam quidem de Eucharistia Opinionem, multis etiam cum complicibus & asseclis secutus, crudè tamen nonnihil, panem consecratum, corporis Christi Figuram propemodum nudam, dicere visus est.
